gate.decision: improvement iff S > 0 and p < alpha, where for every held-out task t the base and the candidate each run `runs` single attempts, S = Σ_t (candidate passes_t − base passes_t), and p is the exact one-sided stratified permutation p-value: with k_t = base passes_t + candidate passes_t, the candidate's `runs` labels among the task's 2·runs attempts are exchangeable, so candidate passes_t ~ Hypergeometric(2·runs, k_t, runs) independently across the H tasks, and p is the probability that the convolution of those H distributions reaches at least the observed S. The test needs at least `minTasks` held-out tasks.
